_comment: Hand-typed rows for tools/build_pdk_data.py. generated: per cifoutput layer, the device shapes the F1 enclosure check measures (types: the Magic type or alias named in the gdsii style's statement that grows the layer from that shape); the builder takes the distance and the tech-file line from the parser. A row may add grow_um, file and line by hand where the parser gives none. rule_ids name the foundry rule for that enclosure, from the GAPS documents or, where _source cites them, the foundry's published rules. layers: corrections to a layer row, keyed by GDS layer/datatype, each with the tech-file line in _line.

NSDM._source: SkyWater periphery rules (google/skywater-pdk 7198cf6), n/ psd.5b: enclosure of tap by nsdm(psdm), 0.125

NPC._source: GAPS-sky130A 3.2 a_no_npc, c_npc_narrow; SkyWater periphery rules (google/skywater-pdk 7198cf6), licon.15: poly_licon must be enclosed by npc by 0.100

HVTP._source: GAPS-sky130A 3.2 i_hvtp_w030; SkyWater periphery rules (google/skywater-pdk 7198cf6), hvtp.3: min enclosure of pfet by hvtp, 0.180 (hvtp.4 is the spacing between pfet and hvtp)

LVTN._source: SkyWater periphery rules (google/skywater-pdk 7198cf6), lvtn.4b: min enclosure of gate by lvtn, 0.180

PSD._source: GAPS-ihp-sg13cmos5l 2.2 u_pSD.c (pSD 0.18 past the Activ); GAPS-ihp-sg13g2 4 H_pmos_psdflush

16/0._line: ihp-sg13cmos5l-cifin.tech:1127 (calma DIGITALID 16 0); as ihp-sg13g2 (GAPS-ihp-sg13g2 8), whose .lyp has DigiSub on 60/0; this PDK's .lyp has no DigiSub
